script_text: The cosmos is cracking open a door Capricorn did not know was locked. Early week Monday through Wednesday, your ruler Saturn in your 2nd House squares Mercury Retrograde in your 11th House, making Tuesday worst for career negotiations as contracts stall. Venus in your 7th House trines Mars in your 10th House on Wednesday, blessing committed love with passionate career-backed stability. Mid-week the Sun enters your 8th House on Thursday, shifting focus to shared resources and intimacy. Late week Thursday through Sunday, Jupiter sextiles Pluto in your 1st House, expanding personal power; the weekend favors deep financial talks with a partner. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trines Mars igniting love and ambition. Tuesday is worst due to the Saturn-Mercury square blocking money matters. Draft agreements Monday, sign Thursday. Follow for daily updates.
